data.long_meaning: Originating from the Old English word 'beallian' meaning 'to throw', 'Balling' refers to the act of handling, throwing, or moving a ball. This name can be given to a child who is energetic, active, and enjoys sports or games. The name Balling carries the meaning “Relating to a ball” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English. Parents who choose Balling usually hope their child will grow to embody relating to a ball and live with faith, good character and purpose.
